data.title: Payment reminder: Reitbeteiligung fees April/May 2026
data.summary: Reitstall Beispielhof sent a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) to Nele Musterkamp for two outstanding monthly riding-share (Reitbeteiligung) fees of €120.00 each for the horse "Fenja", totaling €240.00, requesting payment by 10 June 2026.
data.explanation: The riding stable says you still owe €240.00 for the April and May 2026 riding-share fees (€120.00 each). They ask you to transfer this amount by the deadline shown, using the reference printed on the letter, so they can keep planning your riding times for June as usual. Note that the letter also prints a separate, later "Fälligkeit" (due date) of 19 June 2026, which is inconsistent with the requested payment date — it may be worth confirming the correct date with the stable. If you don't pay, the stable indicates your June riding times may not be scheduled as usual.

items.title: Pay the overdue riding-share fees for April and May 2026
items.action: Transfer €240.00 to the stable's account using the payment reference shown.
items.consequence: The stable says riding times for June may not be scheduled as usual if the payment is not made.
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie die 240,00 € bis zum 10.06.2026, damit wir die Reitzeiten für Juni wie gewohnt einplanen können.
